question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as core plugin/config API, or keep the current single active memory slot model?
rationale: VISION.md currently says memory has one active plugin slot and plans to converge on one recommended default, while the issue demonstrates a real plugin API composition gap that cannot be solved by a small bug fix alone.

options.title: Accept role slots
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the implementation path after resolving conflicts and requiring fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow to coexistence fixes
options.body: Fix only specific gaps such as dreaming/status warnings while deferring the broader role-slot schema.

options.title: Keep single-slot policy
options.body: Reject the architecture for now, document the current memory composition limits, and close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept role slots
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the implementation path after resolving conflicts and requiring fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal points to plugin config and memory runtime ownership, including original memory slot work and recent plugin docs/config changes.
